page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. Utilizing the x86_64 architecture, this instance allocates exactly one thread per core, ensuring dedicated CPU resources without hyperthreading overhead.

The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating systems and data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 30 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between instances and cloud services.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and balanced resource density make this instance suitable for workloads requiring consistent compute performance without the resource contention of shared-core environments. It is designed for enterprise applications, web serving, database hosting, and general-purpose workloads that benefit from a 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio and high network throughput.
